integration.pdl: gfx1201 modules rebuilt from the staged .hip. HIP_PDL_KERNELS is the source default, and _pdl is present in multihead-fast-padded-wave, its packed variant, and multihead_fused_attention. LmxxfProductionOptions sets opt.pdl true and keeps graph false. Author measured about 1.6% at 900p and 0.6% at 1080p, bit-identical. This machine did not re-hash network outputs.
integration.strength: Menu sliders, PrepareFrame, and LmxxfBackend accept detail and colour strength 0..3. Default stays 1. Above 1 extrapolates past the network result.
integration.paper_white: LmxxfPaperWhite defaults to 1, must be finite and in (0, 64], and is passed to encode and decode Record. It is not the HDR Paper White anchor. Hosts that still send the 104-byte frame info get 1.
integration.encoder: RecordInputs uses the frame strengths. It does not call LegacyParameters(), so Cyberpunk2077.exe is not forced to colour strength 0. Every game follows the sliders and still defaults to 1 and 1.
